title: The Adeno-Associated Virus Replication Protein Rep78 Contains a Strictly C-Terminal Sequence Motif Conserved Across Dependoparvoviruses.
one_liner_zh: 该文研究AAV复制蛋白Rep78的C端保守序列基序，虽涉及蛋白-DNA结合界面推测，但无AI或物理模拟方法，且非TF-DNA体系，仅边缘相关。
abstract: Adeno-Associated Viruses (AAVs, genus Dependoparvovirus) are the leading gene therapy vector. Until recently, efforts to enhance their capacity for gene delivery had focused on their capsids. However, efforts are increasingly shifting towards improving the viral replication protein, Rep78. We discovered that Rep78 and its shorter isoform Rep52 contain a strictly C-terminal sequence motif, DDx3EQ, conserved in most dependoparvoviruses. The motif is highly negatively charged and devoid of prolines. Its wide conservation suggests that it is required for the life cycle of dependoparvoviruses. Despite its short length, the motif's strictly C-terminal position has the potential to endow it with a high recognition specificity. A candidate target of the DDx3EQ motif might be the DNA-binding interface of the origin-binding domain of Rep78, which is highly positively charged. Published studies suggest that this motif is not required for recombinant AAV production, but that substitutions within it might improve production.
abstract_zh: 腺相关病毒（AAVs，属Dependoparvovirus属）是领先的基因治疗载体。直到最近，增强其基因递送能力的努力主要集中在其衣壳上。然而，研究重心正日益转向改善病毒复制蛋白Rep78。我们发现Rep78及其较短亚型Rep52含有一个严格位于C端的序列基序DDx3EQ，该基序在大多数依赖细小病毒中保守。该基序高度带负电荷且不含脯氨酸。其广泛保守性表明它对于依赖细小病毒的生命周期是必需的。尽管长度较短，但该基序严格位于C端的位置可能赋予其高识别特异性。DDx3EQ基序的一个候选靶标可能是Rep78的起源结合域的DNA结合界面，该界面高度带正电荷。已发表的研究表明，该基序并非重组AAV生产所必需，但其内的替换可能改善生产。
